text: The pipeline begins with an unconstrained two-dimensional input image of a face.
A convolutional neural network processes the image in a single pass to predict intermediate three-dimensional representations.
Specifically, the network predicts the Projected Normalized Coordinate Code, providing a dense set of facial landmarks.
In parallel, it outputs a three-dimensional offset image to capture precise geometric details.
Together, the coordinate codes and offsets fully specify a dense three-dimensional point cloud.
Alternatively, the predicted facial geometry is used as linear constraints to directly estimate parameters for a three-dimensional morphable model.
